props.name: defaultPressed
props.description: Whether the toggle button is currently pressed. This is the uncontrolled counterpart of `pressed`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.

props.name: nativeButton
props.description: Whether the component renders a native `<button>` element when replacing it via the `render` prop. Set to `false` if the rendered element is not a button (for example, `<div>`).

props.name: pressed
props.description: Whether the toggle button is currently pressed. This is the controlled counterpart of `defaultPressed`.

props.name: value
props.description: A unique string that identifies the toggle when used inside a toggle group.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The pressed state of the toggle group represented by an array of the values of all pressed toggle buttons. This is the uncontrolled counterpart of `value`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the toggle group should ignore user interaction.

props.name: loopFocus
props.description: Whether to loop keyboard focus back to the first item when the end of the list is reached while using the arrow keys.

props.name: multiple
props.description: When `false` only one item in the group can be pressed. If any item in the group becomes pressed, the others will become unpressed. When `true` multiple items can be pressed.
